claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Pad 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
NASA's Artemis II mission is a crewed mission.
NASA's Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first to carry humans to the moon since 1972.
Four astronauts were aboard the Orion spacecraft for NASA's Artemis II mission.
The launch date of NASA's Artemis II mission was Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The launch time of NASA's Artemis II mission was 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The crew of NASA's Artemis II mission consisted of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The goal of NASA's Artemis II mission was a 10-day test flight to test the Orion capsule with a crew for the first time.
